title: Mixed Duo #26
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: French, in her mid 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 50 drop dangles piercings set with diamonds in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver a bracelet. Painted in Italian Deruta majolica, a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing with both arms raised overhead, elbows bent, torso fully visible, extreme cobalt-and-ochre extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Brazilian, in her mid 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in long thick box braids, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal a ring. Painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern, a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
